item.title: Residents, commissioners react to possible ICE detention center in Hertford Co.
item.description: The Hertford County Board of Commissioners will meet Feb. 16 for a regularly scheduled meeting. WAVY has learned that plans for a potential Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) detention center at the Rivers Correctional Facility in Winton will be discussed during the meeting.

item.title: Docs: Man charged in Norfolk murder has fled to Hong Kong
item.description: The man charged with killing his wife in Norfolk has fled the United States and was last known to be in Hong Kong, according to a federal affidavit.
